description: Retrieve SARS Section 8(1)(b) compliant business and private travel logs, including trip date, starting odometer, ending odometer, distance in km, destination, and specific business purpose.

is_business.description: Filter by business travel (true) or private travel (false). Omit to return both.

limit.description: Maximum number of trips to return (default 50, max 200).

vehicle_id.description: Optional ID of a specific vehicle to filter trips.

name: list_sars_trips
